trends.name: Sharp Tailoring
trends.summary: Tailoring is getting cleaner and sharper again - fitted, structured pieces in quiet colours.
trends.why: The Impression's fall 2026 men's overview describes structured tailoring with sharp shoulders and grey-on-grey palettes, and Numéro lists slim classic tailoring among the trends of the FW26-27 men's shows.

trends.name: Ladylike Suiting
trends.summary: Polished suiting is back - blazers with skirts or high-waisted trousers, worn with a modern twist.
trends.why: Coveteur's fall 2026 trends include skirt suits and ladylike tailoring, and Trendalytics' FW26 recap names skirt suiting and high-waisted trousers among the season's key silhouettes.

trends.name: The Minimalist Dress
trends.summary: One clean, simple dress doing all the work - no fuss, just a good shape.
meaning: a plain midi or maxi dress
trends.why: NET-A-PORTER's fall/winter 2026 trend edit names the minimalist dress - simple midis and maxis with clean lines - as a key look.

trends.name: Grey Is the New Neutral
trends.summary: Grey is replacing brown as the go-to neutral this season.
meaning: grey with black, white or navy
trends.why: Trendalytics' FW26 recap reports grey overtaking brown as the dominant neutral, and The Impression notes grey-on-grey palettes in the fall 2026 men's shows.

trends.name: Layers Upon Layers
trends.summary: More is more - stacking a jacket, blazer or cardigan over your outfit to add depth.
meaning: a jacket, blazer, coat or cardigan on top
trends.why: NET-A-PORTER's FW26 edit calls out 'layers upon layers', and Trendalytics' recap describes a 'More Is More' direction built on layering.

slots.label: a layer (jacket, blazer, coat or cardigan)

trends.name: Dark Romance
trends.summary: Moody, romantic dressing in black and deep wine shades.
meaning: lace, velvet or high necklines if you have them
trends.why: Coveteur ('Night Moves'), NET-A-PORTER ('gothic romance') and Trendalytics ('The Other Side') all name dark, romantic eveningwear for fall 2026.

trends.name: Jewel-Tone Colour
trends.summary: Rich colour is in - bottle green, scarlet, purple and ochre, head-to-toe or as one bold piece.
trends.why: NET-A-PORTER lists bottle green, ochre, scarlet and purple as FW26 key colours, and Numéro reports red taking over the men's FW26-27 shows.

trends.name: On the Grid: Checks & Tartan
trends.summary: Checks, plaids and tartan are everywhere - on shirts, coats and skirts.
trends.why: Coveteur's fall 2026 trends include checks, tartan and gingham ('On The Grid'), and Numéro reports bigger, high-contrast tartans in the men's FW26-27 shows.

recipe.pattern_note: We can see that a piece is printed, not exactly which print - so any patterned piece counts.

trends.name: Khaki Coded
trends.summary: An explorer feel - khaki, beige and earthy browns with relaxed shirts and pleated trousers.
meaning: khaki, beige, olive or brown pieces
trends.why: Pinterest Predicts 2026 named 'Khaki Coded'; as reported by FashionUnited, searches rose for brown linen shirts (+100%), field jacket outfit men (+65%) and pleated trousers (+30%).

trends.name: Poetcore
trends.summary: A literary, slightly vintage look - blazers, shirts and ties with a romantic edge.
meaning: a tie, satchel or brooch as the detail
trends.why: Pinterest Predicts 2026 named 'Poetcore'; as reported by FashionUnited, searches rose for 'the poet aesthetic' (+175%), 'tie accessories' (+85%) and 'poet core' (+75%). Numéro's 'rock-dandy' men's trend is close in spirit.

trends.name: Smart-Casual Knits
trends.summary: Preppy, easy smartness - a cardigan or knit over a shirt with tailored trousers.
trends.why: The Impression's fall 2026 men's overview highlights smart casualwear - fair-isle knits, cardigans and pleat-front or straight-leg tailored trousers.

trends.name: Bermuda Shorts
trends.summary: Longer, knee-length shorts styled up with a proper shirt.
meaning: a shirt or polo instead of a tee
trends.why: Numéro lists wide Bermuda shorts falling below the knee among the FW26-27 men's trends, and Pinterest Predicts 2026 ('Khaki Coded') mentions bermuda shorts too.

trends.name: Folk Tales
trends.summary: Cosy, countryside-inspired pieces - skirts with knits and boots.
meaning: a skirt (tiered if you have one)
trends.why: NET-A-PORTER's FW26 edit names 'folk tales' - tiered skirts, checked dresses, hand-knit sweaters and Western-style boots.

trends.name: Short Kurta, Modern Pairing
trends.summary: Shorter kurtas styled lighter and more modern for everyday wear.
trends.why: House of Kari's ethnic wear trends 2026 lists short kurtas worn with straight pants, palazzos or jeans, and Chikankari in modern silhouettes.
trends.rule_note: The trend also pairs kurtas with jeans. Your styling rules keep ethnic and western pieces apart, so your version uses palazzos, salwar or leggings.

trends.name: Ethnic Co-ord Sets
trends.summary: Matching ethnic sets - one easy outfit you can dress up or down.
meaning: a matching kurta set or suit
trends.why: House of Kari names co-ord sets (including Chikankari cotton co-ords) for 2026, and Aza Fashions lists printed co-ord sets among its festive fusion ideas for 2026.

slots.label: a kurta set or salwar suit

trends.name: Pastel Festive
trends.summary: Soft pastels for day festivities - lavender, sage, blush and ivory.
meaning: an ethnic outfit in a pastel shade
trends.why: House of Kari lists pastel shades (lavender, sage, blush pink, powder blue, ivory) for 2026, and Lashkaraa's 2026 festive report saw sage green, dusty rose and ivory emerging.

trends.name: Jewel-Tone Festive Night
trends.summary: Deep jewel colours for the big festive night - emerald, wine, royal blue.
meaning: emerald, wine, burgundy, teal or royal blue
trends.why: House of Kari names rich jewel tones (emerald, wine, burgundy, deep teal) for evening and festive wear in 2026, and Lashkaraa's 2026 report found partywear lehengas and sarees in jewel tones dominated Diwali night.

trends.name: Indo-Western Fusion
trends.summary: Indian pieces in western shapes - dhoti pants with crop tops, sari gowns, jacket lehengas.
meaning: a pre-stitched sari gown or kurta dress
a jacket worn in place of a blouse
trends.why: Aza Fashions' 2026 festive fusion ideas include dhoti pants with an embellished crop top, sari gowns and jacket lehengas, and Lashkaraa's 2026 report lists pre-draped sarees and cape dupattas as emerging.
trends.rule_note: This trend mixes ethnic and western pieces in one outfit. Your styling rules keep them separate, so it's shown as inspiration only.

trends.name: Kurta + Nehru Jacket
trends.summary: A jacket over the kurta - the festive look that feels dressed-up without a sherwani.
meaning: a kurta with pajama or churidar
a Nehru or embroidered jacket on top
trends.why: Kisah's Diwali 2026 men's guide recommends embroidered-jacket kurta sets and sequined Nehru jacket sets for evening festivities, and advises against casual sneakers.

trends.name: Clean Kurta Set
trends.summary: A shorter, cleaner kurta set in a rich festive colour.
meaning: a kurta with pajama or churidar (or a kurta set)
emerald, royal blue, maroon, mustard or ivory
trends.why: Kisah's Diwali 2026 men's guide recommends mid-length kurta trouser sets and names emerald, royal blue, maroon, mustard, rust and ivory as festive shades.

slots.label: a kurta set, or kurta with pajama

trends.name: Brooched
trends.summary: A brooch pinned to a jacket, blazer or Nehru jacket - small detail, big personality.
meaning: a blazer, jacket or Nehru jacket
one brooch - vintage, heirloom or playful
trends.why: Pinterest Predicts 2026 named 'Brooched'; as reported by FashionUnited, searches rose for 'brooch aesthetic' (+110%), 'brooch for men suit' (+90%) and 'heirloom jewelry' (+45%).

accessory_gap.label: a brooch
accessory_gap.note: Brooches aren't a wardrobe category yet, so we can't see if you own one.

slots.label: a blazer, jacket or Nehru jacket
